note: Reviewer names omitted. Order is the Play page default, not by date. Not a complete set. In this sample 333 of 540 reviews are 1 or 2 stars (62%); the shown order is the page's default, so these counts are not the app's overall rating.

reviews.text: I really hate to do this, but you changed the app and now it looks TERRIBLE! I used to be able to see what the hypertension levels were defined as. Now I can't. I liked being able to see the heart image in big color. It was nice. Now you replaced it with a list. Tap on a reading and what does it show? A list of readings in a different format. I'm an engineer, so I like data, but I also like aesthetics, and this has none.

For years this has been a good app. However an update in July had all the information going over to the app and then disappearing. Luckily I had a backup on an Excel sheet because of a doctor visit but I could have lost critical information as I take my blood pressure almost daily for a medical reason. Discovered the problem was because of a update and had to disconnect and reconnect my device and hopefully it will be working. if I didn't have a backup would have lost two months worth of info.

For 2 years the app and the device worked great. A few months later they completely changed the app and they made it bad. One star is not for the device it works well, but many other products do the same, the app is what makes the difference. The original app was excellent, but now you cannot even see your individual readings from the past. I'm sure they're saving on data centers. Here's an idea: make the app to store the person data on the phone itself. Unless you're going to start charging.

it doesn't want to sync up again. android os12, all updates. cleared the cache, restarted the phone, repeated pairing more times than I can recall. I've done troubleshooting on the Bluetooth --no issues there. I'd love to share with my PCP but if I can't get it to sync, what's the point. Much improved. Syncing sometimes is still an issue but I believe it is often an issue with the phone rather than the app.

Its great when it works which is not very often. It never connects to the machine on it's own anymore. The app freezes up every time I open it. Sometimes if I tap a few options I can eventually get it to work but this time its just stuck. I guess Ill have to reistall it and get the paid version to keep my blood pressure records. Sad really. I spent a lot of money on the machine for this app.

Update 6/30/26: Latest app update eliminated useful/critical color-coded reporting of daily BP results!! Removing one star. The blood pressure measurements are accurate, and it is very useful to have it connect to the app. The app, however, has some issues. The update between the unit and the app doesn't always connect automatically as it should. And the labels on the history cover up important data. But all the information you need is there and can be found with just a bit of effort.

UPDATE Downgrading to 1 star... transferring readings unreliable/intermittent. Hasn't updated since last evening. Unpaired and re-paired device. Now it says there are no new readings to transfer! None of today's readings were transferred! Last week I uninstalled and re-installed app and although it started working, all past months readings are gone.

Works Occasionally The base unit and cuff work fine, but the Bluetooth function is ludicrously ineffective. Sometimes the Bluetooth is functional, but MOST of the time it DOES NOT. I know how to toggle it off & on in the app, on the device and on my phone. Despite all of it being turned on the app insists there is no Bluetooth connection. Fortunately the app does allow you to enter data manually. 2026 & technology is still having Bluetooth issues. pathetic

Pathetically slow, and demands all your contact info to sell to advertisers before it even trys to connect with Bluetooth, which failed, even within inches of the device. I've replaced it with a 10 line shell script. I have to type in the three numbers, but even I can do that quicker than using this app. Delete.

Very poorly supported app. No longer syncs clock on the bp monitor nor does it wake it up to get the readings. Resetting the app to try and correct these issues loses all data collected over the years as cloud sync is also broken. Customer support is useless and in denial telling you to reboot your phone, logout and login instead of owning up to these regressions.

This app has worked fairly well for me for the past 10 months that I have been using it. But as of a couple days ago all of my weight data from July 3rd 2026 to August 2nd 2026 disappeared in the app. Hopefully it will magically reappear. I use the app to track my blood pressure and my weight. All of my blood pressure data is is still available for me to see in the app. All my weight data is still available in Health Connect so I can see it in Google Fit and Google Health.

Have to pay for premium!!! , Very disappointed that it will not sync with my Garmin vivo active watch or the Garmin app. Not sure I will keep using this app since I manually enter my blood pressure in the Garmin app and my net diary. I thought it would sync that's why I bought it said it monitors your blood pressure, but it does not, only works with syncing to Google fit unfortunately. I don't see need for it 🙁 plus you have to pay for the advanced features, This was not mentioned on Amazon ..
1 person found this review helpful

I do love the app that accompanies the unit, espe I'll the notes feature that you can add to your BP reading. Only reason that it's not a 5 is because I think the touch sensors for the EKG unit is not consistent. The readings varies with touch pressure & movement. Maybe they can improve that portion to get a 5. The membership services also offers other features that is helpful. Without membership, you can also get a pdf file of the BP history. It came in handy to show my doctor.

older version of this app worked well. BP readings went to my phone immediately after checking BP. Now, I never know when they are going to show up. they can show up right away or in 24 hours or more. when I need to pull a report for my doctor, I have to reboot my phone to get all the readings to show up before sending a report to email. The developer needs to look at how cache is handled and check for memory leaks.

Update to my last post. Home screen is stiil horrible with hard to read font and colors. Basic information still scattered on screen and not concise like older version. Previous version was much easier to read basic information. Not against change as long as it's an improvement. This did not accomplish that. Dropped rating to one star. Please improve!

This app was running great until the last update. Now it crashes and puts up a popup giving me a choice to close app or wait. Not enough hours in the day to wait so I close it and keep trying until it finally connects. It did not play these games until the last update. Don't like the new averaging stuff either. If it ain't broke don't fix it! You made it worse. This is the next day... now it will not sync. It is pretty much useless at this point. FIX IT. Working better. updated rating.

After almost 6 years the app updates allow my Google Pixel to sync with my BP6350 Monitor. I love that it does it automatically. However, when there's an update to the app, I'm not notified, it just stops syncing and I have to go digging around to troubleshoot and repair my phone Bluetooth with the BP monitor. Other than that the monitor works well! It would have been perfect if it also shared data with my Google Fitbit app i.e. weight and BP readings.

all if okay. I wish I didn't have to press Got It every time the App starts up. the Do not show this again check box does not work. Also at one point. maybe still is, the App would start up scrolled down a page in so I often have to scroll up to top to see that it synced. And it should sync or auto sync without me pushing the button on the device AND on the App.

crashes constantly since around may 20. I have tried everything. Every time I go to Devices, it fades to black and tells me to close app. Very very annoying. Update: Version 2026.06.09 - no devices attached to BT. Now when I go to Connect your device it comes up with a Pair your Heart Guide screen and stalls with 3 hopping dots forever. Don't your developers test apps before release?

The app is totally unusable. During the registration process, the app tells me the email and password are incorrect, despite hitting the registration button and NOT the sign in button. I have never had an account for any Omron product or website, so the email and password are not the issue. Despite trying multiple email addresses and passwords, I cannot create an account. This makes me second guess my purchase of an Omron blood pressure monitor. Very disappointed.

it's last version was good. this version doesn't show all blood pressures, if you choose the average option. it only shows historical entries on a graph. not very useful. reply to OMRON. I finally found it. First list should the default and it should be easier to find. It should also be a set in the settings.

I have used Omron & connect app for 5 years. In beginning my BP786N synced awesome with the app & allowed me to generate full pdf reports that I shared with my doctor every 3 mos. But as the connect app grew in functionality it grew in problems. The automatic sync stopped working; now requires manual one. A pay-for-reports model came called Premium. I don't think that is totally right because of constant sync problems, having to reinstall the app, & other functionality I don't use. Disappointed.

After using the app for a year w/mostly satisfactory results, The Bluetooth connection process broke during the first week of April after an app update. Omron sent me a new machine and it won't connect to the app during pairing either, even though it connects to my mobile Bluetooth. I am losing my patience with Bluetooth BP machines completely. I should follow my BP but it's becoming a cause of hypertension trying to use these things. I might just go back to a notebook because it never fails.

I bought the smart scale a few years ago for integration to apps. It worked for a while but Omron Connect hasn't kept up with integrations and changes to Fitbit/Health Connect and now Google Health / Google Fit. I want to send my weight readings seamlessly from my scale to Macrofactor, but have given up on trying. It's not worth the effort, so I log my weight into Macrofactor the old fashioned way.

Update: The automatic notifications are working again as noted on 6/16/2026. The app used to work without issues. Now it won't sync automatically. Most of the time you can manually sync but at times it won't sync at all. I have tried unpairing and repairing several times but it did not fix the auto sync issue.

Last Updated changed everything! Why mess with something that works..... never understand this. Will no longer sync properly and I refuse to keep manually doing this. I honestly think I will just delete the app... because it no longer functions like it should. Whatever you did in this last software update... PLEASE CHANGE IT BACK!

The recent interface update is less user friendly and unnecessary. Can't quickly view averages. Also, the yearly average for BP is now showing the monthly average; the 6 month shows a weekly average; monthly also displays weekly average; weekly displays daily. Daily average just shows my most recent reading, not an average. Patiently waiting for a fix, but the app is near pointless at the moment.

This app is unreliable. Especially since the update 6 days ago. 3/4 of the time it can't connect. It has lost showing notification and sound. I have cleared data and cache. I have forced stopped. I have removed the blood pressure cuff and installed it again. to get Bluetooth connectivity. I have tried users 1 and 2. It's totally ridiculous already. using it on a Note 10+ and none of my other apps are having problems Sorry, this page can't be found. that's when I hit your email support

I have now cancelled my subscription that expires in two days. The information tells me that it will remain active until it expires, but that was not true. The premium benefits disappeared as soon as I cancelled. The below problem resolved, presumably after an update. It logs out every day and unlinks the linked app. This means that I need to log in every day and link with the other apps every day. This is not good.

Poor user experience. There is no way to delete all historical data in the app. You either have to do it 1 entry at a time or delete the history from the bp machine then sync with the app. The failure is if there are multiple users of the bp machine. There is also no profile settings in the app to manually set sync options. If your bluetooth is on it automatically syncs. The website is no better. Also noted that it does NOT sync with Samsung health despite it being an option.

The good: syncing didn't work in 2021 but now usually works well and all of the previous issues (AM/PM display, "Don't show again" box, wrong sync instructions) were fixed fairly quickly. The bad: sometimes, one of the cuffs (BP7000) stops syncing and has to be re-paired and synced manually. The ugly: general app design and especially the chart view.

We have an older BP7000 and thought it might be getting a little iffy so we purchased a new BP5255 and have tried to get 2 of the four users on the app. I have found there is no way to separate the readings into separate users. Please make your app multi-user otherwise it's sort of useless to have multiple users on the blood pressure cuff machines!

The app is mostly unusable unless I input data manually. It refuses to connect via Bluetooth to my Motorola Power 5g. I uninstalled, deleted the device, reinstalled, reconnected, etc. Contacted Omron tech support twice. It has been two months. Nothing. Come on, Bluetooth connect technology is not exactly cutting edge. I have never encountered another device that was designed to be connected by Bluetooth that my phone would not connect to... until now.

I have a blood pressure machine. All I want is easy access to my blood pressure readings. The app requires access to all sorts of things when instlled. For a while the app stopped working on my phone.installed. not get to history. I disabled all permissions except "Devices near me". Now the app shows my blood pressure history again. For me it is better than before as I don't want my apps to access pictures, phone, activity, contacts, etc.

Don't like to provide negative reviews, but very disappointed. Switched from M6 to M7. The region where I live (Georgia) Omron Connect app is with extremely limited features: reports are very limited, problems with syncing. I re-registered it for the UK (as a random choice) and opted for premium. The reports are showing only the last 2 days, even though the headings show the time span I choose from filters. Noting to share with my cardiologist, my main objective: sync the readings and then share

I am comparing to the older version which was much more user friendly. The auto sync is awful. It causes the app to run in the background and use resources when they are not needed. The rollout of the new version was without warning, I could not save my data, a d was less than seamless. The help desk at Omron was friendly, reassuring, and competent when reached by phone.

Inconsistent synchronizing. Have to press the bluetooth button on the machine about every third session. Other than that, easy to use, export feature is great! In response to Omron support: Autosync has been turned on since I set up the app 8 months ago. The phone is less than 10 feet away from the monitor. Autosync works most of the time, just not ALL of the time, which is why I said it's inconsistent. Since I'm not a beta tester, I won't be helping you troubleshoot.

The old app was clearer, easier to understand, and did more... but you can't use it anymore. I don't like when the manufacturer forces you to "upgrade" to new devices, or apps. I expected to have to unpaired my monitor and pair it again, but there is absolutely no reason that you have to give location permission now. It connected before by Bluetooth and it still should, but won't unless you give permission for location access. Perhaps it should be called mandatory instead of permission, which implies that you have a choice. You don't... except for the choice not to use at all. It used to connect to Walgreens app to aid in bonus points, it no longer does. When it transferred my readings, some of the trueread listing now show all 3 readings, and some just show a single. You can tap the single reading to show all 3, but then on a different day, it records all as if they were separate readings. The graphs are smaller and harder to read, you also have to scroll through to see the year as others noted. What seems to be missing is that before you could tap on the year and see the average reading in numbers, now you just get the dots and no actual numbers. You should also be able to change the levels, because what is normal for me, would be considered high for others. You can't do that. In general, this is a perfect example of "if it isn't broke, don't fix it", well they did and now it is broken and not nearly as good. For one of the most popular and most recommended by doctors monitors, this is awful now and as always, that is the truth.

Marginally useful when it works. After not using it for a month, it kept crashing, then after totally erasing all data, it finally ran, got configured, and connected. But then, all the time/dates were missing on my device since the last run, and it was unable to download any recent readings. I had to go through setting time, which was already set, and now it works but I've lost a month's data. Also, for some reason, it will not even run in my doctor's office for some reason. Very disappointing!

This app is no longer working on my Pixel 6. When I open the app, I can't access anything, the screen is frozen. All my blood pressure and weight data is stored in it. I have uninstalled and reinstalled. UPDATE: The app is now loading correctly. I'm having a problem with my most recent weight readings not syncing but I think that's because I uninstalled and reinstalled the app and those are weights I took before re-pairing the scale to the app.

This app worked great for well over a year, then suddenly, it stopped. It will record a reading, but history no longer works, then I realized nothing works. Everything I click on is unresponsive. Not sure what happened to it, is it my phone, or the app? I don't want to delete it & reinstall it because I'll lose all my history. I can't access it, so I guess it doesn't matter if I delete it & reinstall it.

I bought the blood pressure device because it said that it would integrate with Google Fit. The physical blood pressure device is great, especially for the price. The connectivity however doesn't work, for me. Done tech support twice, not sure they understand what's going on either. At the moment, I'm exporting the data via Excel, which works well. But having to manually key the data is what I bought the thing to try to avoid. So that's disappointing.

This app is really bad. It worked fine for about a week, despite BP readings not syncing to the correct phone (for my wife and I). Now, over the last 3 weeks, my readings don’t sync automatically and only sync after turning the monitor off, pressing the BT button, and then pressing sync again. Then today, after pressing sync, the app said to add a device! After re-adding the device, all my BP readings were gone from history!

Update(11.30.24): latest update 7.21.1 fixed the syncing issue, happy that everything seems to be working again. 4⭐ DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME Was working, but was forced to do an update (Nov 2024) and now it will no longer auto sync. If I have to manually sync every time I take a reading, there is no need for the app. I guess they're just using the app to collect your personal data off your phone. And based on all the other comments, it's obvious they have no interest in fixing the issue. ZERO star!

The subscription model is silly. Many other apps that can provide more meaningful interpretation with the context of the additional data they collect (HRV, activity, diet, etc) and have access to, and their interface is better designed than Omron's. As a means to record that data and insert into a dataset about you (so those other apps can make use of it), it works fine. Would be nice to see a historical graph of readings for those of us who measure regularly.

The login process is very glitchy. I created a password with more the 20 characters. The app saw no issues with that, sent the email to confirm, which I clicked on, and then got the email saying my account was confirmed. But it would not let me log in and told me to call support (which I did but they were not open). So I reset the password and only NOW it informs me the password must be under 20 characters. So I made a weaker password and was able to log in. So annoying

Good for gathering data but not great for navigation or "insights". I use it to track my BP and it says I reached my target, despite my readings being too high and my not having entered a target at all. It also has messages that pop up in the app with a "Read more" that you click on and the entire message disappears and doesn't appear anywhere else within the app.

A good companion to the device itself. Very convenient to see my numbers on my phone. This is the first time I ever had a blood pressure monitor, so I don't always get it right. I usually look at the illustration in the lid of the case to see how I'm supposed to have my arm & all, which works much better for me than the illustration in the manual. 👍🏻 Overall, I'm a very satisfied customer & give both the app & device itself 5 stars... 😄

I've had had the BP786N since August 2017, and the older Android app worked fine. When OMRON changed the app to OMRON CONNECT, it came with bugs, but it did work. After the March 2020 update...well, like everyone has already said...it sucks. Will not upload data. Period. I understand you can buy the "key" (subscription) to unlock all the features, but it costs more that 2 new BPMs! Oh, if all you want or need is to monitor your BP from time to time, this will work fine as long as you have paper and pencil (sort of pre-computer age way of tracking). I'm on the hunt for a better, more reliable device, even it costs a little more. But I wouldn't recommend it because of the falsed information.

Love the automation in tracking my BP stats. But this app stinks at 2some basics: since weight is manually entered, there is no means to correct an erroneous entry. The same goes for manually entered BP readings. Plus, when entering your birthday in your profile data, you can't simply enter the data. You have to scroll back through a calendar one month at a time....through all of your years.
1 person found this review helpful

Won't let me push buttons on the app. Please help! I really like the automated recordkeeping from the BP machine and that I can manually record my own weight from my own bathroom scale. However, it recently won't let me push buttons on the app. It still records BP via Bluetooth but i cannot do anything with any buttons on the app. None of the buttons respond. Please help. Thx. BTW, "Tell us more (optional)" below does not work. It won't load so I can't type in it.

I will update this review when I have more experience with the app. For starters, I was able to install the app and pair it to my phone with a bit of tinkering. It wasn't 100% clean though. Instructions are mostly ok, but a little confusing, as they were clearly written by someone who doesn't speak English as a first language. Also, when I clicked on Omron's privacy / data-sharing policy, my android produced a BLANK page (I was able to read the policy on my PC). It seems the company does not have it's act together.

The app was working fine until the update. The app is user unfriendly, I don't know why you would mess with something that was working well. I lost most of the data that I had prior to the update. Please revert back to what was working. I have to keep on syncing the app to the blood pressure monitor. I have to sync the machine daily. I have tried deleting and re- installing the app to no avail.

The app generally works well but sometimes when I've tried to get blood pressure + EKG, all I get is blood pressure, if I didn't follow the procedure exactly correctly. My bigger beef with this app is that it requires NFC to be off, and guides you to the setting to do that, but then does nothing to help you turn it back on when finished. This breaks other apps, mainly my mobile payment apps, leaving me fumbling and holding up checkout lines while I look for the setting to turn NFC back on.

The feature to send the report to email doesn't work for me. It says it sent it, but I never received the email. Tried multiple times, all three file formats. Checked Spam folder, not there either. Why? I emailed your support email about it, and got an error message that the email could not be delivered. Has anyone got the send report to email to work?

I don't know if it works or not, I cannot even log in. Put in username and password, hit the Go to dashboard button and it sends me a password reset email!? Log in works fine on website. And, who's genius idea was it to disable paste in password field. Password manager can't fill it in! All you've done is encourage people to use a simple password! Unbelievable!

I really like the app. The reason for 2 stars. The option to connect to your phone. The app wants a full time connection. No option for just when app is being used. You can enter data manually. If I were constantly checking blood pressure all day there would be no problem. Once a day, maybe twice. The app doesn't need access 24 hours a day.

Was just forced to update the new app... Unit is paired but won't transfer any reading... NEVER had an issue with the old app. This app is pointless for me and my husband now... Main reason we went witn this brand was the ease of transferring readings and tracking. I'm sooo disappointed in this app... Will not be recommending it to family or friends... I'm sorry to those I had. Please don't reply with the "please contact us so we can resolve your issue" line! We're all having the same issue! Thx

A great product for blood pressure and heart rate readings. Combined with the app, it privides easy tracking of your numbers with the ability to look back at historical readings over certain time periods. And I like that the app syncs with the machine to record the readings automatically. I would recommend this product and app without hesitation. Easy to set up and easy to use.

Old app worked great. When it updated, it was not obvious how to proceed but after a while I was set up. Set up should be more user friendly. Then I went to put in manual reading. Blood pressure is all I need & i didn't have pulse reading. It would not let me enter the reading without pulse. I didn't want to make one up or enter 0 because the dr sometimes asks about pulse. A 0 or made up reading would mess up the average. With old app to I left it blank. That's why rating isn't higher.

As others have mentioned, it's marginally better than pen and paper tracking. It can track your other health factors such as weight and EKG and share the data with Google fit/ Samsung health, but it can only use data collected by other Omron devices. All readings from my galaxy watch can't be used. The functionality of this app is severely limited unless you have the rest of the devices. Also, needs option to select which wrist you're using, seems to default to left but I can only use my right

This is a fine app for keeping track of your blood pressure, but there are a few annoyances. 1) If my blood pressure is 137/65, the lights on the monitor are green, but the app is yellow and says it's elevated. How hard can it be to have the app agree with the monitor? 2) If I make the font on my phone large, the blood pressure breaks up onto two lines. Why not just make the font as large as it can be in the for the readings? 3) When I close the app, it's still active in the background. Why?

The device, the series 5, is great. I had to get a larger cuff because the cuff that came with the device is too small for my arm. The software is excellent for tracking and reviewing your history. There has been only one issue and that is when I enter notes after my readings. The note needs to be entered twice. Overall a 4.7 out of 5. The Play Store won't allow partial stars.

Now forcing a new license agreement but they don't load!! Parts of it are literally illegal and disgusting. Do NOT give them your data! Keeps getting poorer, I've uninstalled. The new version is not as good as the old version. It now leaves a permanent notification on the notification bar "communicating with device". It takes more clicks to get to the blood pressure view. You can no longer zoom in or out on the charts, so the "daily" ones are pretty useless as you have to scroll so much.

WORST APP EVER! I'm in 20s and not technologically challenging... this is by far one of the worst apps I've ever had to use. The Bluetooth connection is so horrible. Sometimes, it connects, but once it looses the connection, it refuses to sync again. I would not recommend this product or app. Worst of all, if you can't get the app working and log out, you lose ALL of your history! What's the point of having a log in if it doesn't keep your history?! Seriously dissapointed.

uploads and shows the data from the device at the time of use, but it does not organize the data very well. I want a table where bp results are organized by date and time. this app just has a bunch of dots on a line graph, with no labels. Not the best system, IMHO. So, I just use Excel on my computer and enter the data manually. Also, even when the machine is off. it keeps trying to send data to this phone app via Bluetooth. it shortens the life of the device and phone batteries.
1 person found this review helpful

I only use the app and BP machine to monitor my blood pressure. They're easy to set up and use, and agree closely with the numbers I get at my weekly trips to the doctor. It works very well for my simple needs of measuring my bp. The app is very clear at telling you what degree of problem you have per the AHA (I've had RNs read me my hypertensive numbers and merely remark, "It's kinda high; you might want to have that checked.").

This app keeps getting worse and worse. You can't start it without answering some popup that gives you an option to not see, yet it's back again the next time. and you have to kill it, because it repeatedly asks you if the last ekg recording was you when you attempt to run it after a day. This is followed by a black, unclosable dialog that requires you to kill the app and start all over again. This was never run through any qa process.

This app is awful. It has issues with connections. Will not accept anything. I have tried and tried and it keeps saying invalid. Not worth it to say the least. Update: 6/21/25 Still cannot get anything at all. This app is still awful. Cannot even get a password reset, and yes my Bluetooth is on and syn is on. The only thing that gets through is reply that they got my email. Unblieveable.

The best I can say about this app is that it works. It is far worse then the app it replaces, the Omron Welness. The graphs are hard to read and cannot be zoomed in size. The active areas like the date range are too small and miss clicks and thus are hard to activate. The graph is displayed poorly. What is even more annoying is it is one big advertisement for the other "features' Omron sells. The one nice thing about it is the built in "summary report" which you can get in various output formats like pdf. If you use this app, I would recommend trying it.

I've been using this app and related equipment for almost 2 years without any real problems. Now (1/12/2026) I can't even log in!! It just gives me 3 dots and never connects to my account. I've got 2 years of measurements that I can't access. I've even tried reinstalling the app, and same thing happened. I don't know what happened, but if it's not fixed soon, I will be changing equipment.

The software seems to be a bit clunky in my opinion. For instance it was totally unclear to me that the plus sign that on any other application means add another reading manually was also how you do all the configuration. I never tried to touch it. So I finally did touch it and everything that I thought was missing was there. It works fairly well I've had to resync it every time I've used it. We have two people using the blood pressure cuff which this thing is supposed to support.

This new version must be continually running and uses a lot of battery power. Doesn't make sense when the only time it should be connected to phone data is when one is loading the daily blood pressure. I do not like the Program having continual location and acess to other personal files not relevant to blood pressure. I am thinking of deleting it from my phone.

This was the most painful app that I ever tried to install. When creating an account, the password gets rejected and they don't tell you why. You are forced to scroll through 2 terms and conditions docs that are about 11 pages. Who reads these? Why do I need an account to read my blood pressure? Most likely so they can sell my info or market products to me. This app is a hard pass. I never got to the point where I could actually use it after 20 minutes installing and setup.

I've had trouble with this app twice. It logged me off then it didn't recognize my credentials. I had to create a new login and I can only sync the data for the current month. Nothing else syncs. The second time I reset my password and it wants me to agree to the terms and conditions, but the agree button does not work so I can't get past that point.
